cta.title: Chennai • 21 August 2026
cta.body: We call upon Citizens Committed to Democracy and Constitutional Values, students, youth and advocates to participate in large numbers in the Constitution Protection Conference on 21 August 2026 in Chennai. Let us unite together to safeguard the constitutional guarantees and to oppose the forces which consistently threaten the unity and integrity of our great country.

demands.title: Reservation Rights of Backward Class Muslims
demands.tldr: Ensure backward Muslim converts get fair reservation in college admissions & government jobs under TN 2007 Act. Equal rights & opportunities for all!
demands.legalText: The Government of Tamil Nadu should immediately amend the Tamil Nadu Backward Class Muslims (Reservation of Seats in Educational Institutions, including Private Educational Institutions, and of Appointments or Posts in the Services under the State) Act, 2007, to safeguard the reservation rights of socially and educationally backward Muslims who have converted to Islam.

demands.title: Withdraw Unconstitutional FCRA Restrictions
demands.tldr: Stop choking NGOs and charity trusts! Repeal harsh FCRA rules so voluntary orgs can fund free healthcare, schools, and relief for marginalised communities.
demands.legalText: The Union Government must withdraw the unconstitutional amendments to the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA), which adversely affect the lawful utilisation of foreign contributions received by religious institutions, charitable trusts, and voluntary organisations for education, healthcare, social welfare, and humanitarian services benefiting socially and economically marginalised communities.

demands.title: Expedite Impeachment & Inquiry Proceedings
demands.tldr: Hold judges accountable to their constitutional oath! Fast-track impeachment & SC in-house inquiry against Justice Swaminathan for violating Article 219.
demands.legalText: The pending impeachment proceedings in Parliament against Justice G.R. Swaminathan, who has been accused of repeatedly acting contrary to the Constitution and violating the oath taken under Article 219 of the Constitution upon assuming judicial office, should be expedited. Further, the Supreme Court should initiate an in-house inquiry based on the complaint submitted by Members of Parliament to the Chief Justice of India.

demands.title: Extend SC & MBC Reservations to Christians
demands.tldr: Faith shouldn't cost you your affirmative action rights! Amend laws to extend SC & MBC reservation status to eligible Dalit & backward Christians.
demands.legalText: The Union Government should undertake the necessary constitutional and statutory amendments to extend Scheduled Caste reservation benefits to Christians (SC-Christians) in accordance with the constitutional guarantees of equality and freedom of religion. In addition, Most Backward Class reservation (MBC-Christian) should be provided to eligible Most Backward Class persons who have embraced Christianity.
